==Russian==

===Etymology===
Assumed to be related to {{m+|w=1|rom|те терес}} or {{m|rom|тэ тырдэс}} ("to hold, to have, to take, to wait"). Established in dictionaries by the 1850s.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|ты́рить}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|ты́рить|impf|pf=поты́рить,сты́рить}}

# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[pinch]], to [[nick]], to [[steal]]
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to take for one's own, to [[misappropriate]]

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf|4a+p|ты́рить}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*pǫtati}}. Compare {{cog|pl|pętać}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|пу́тать}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-путать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|пу́тать|impf|pf=спу́тать,запу́тать,перепу́тать,впу́тать}}

# to [[tangle]]
#: {{pf|ru|спу́тать|запу́тать}}
# to [[mix up]] (with), to [[confuse]] (with)
#: {{pf|ru|перепу́тать}}
# to [[confuse]]
#: {{pf|ru|запу́тать}}
# to get mixed up, to [[confuse]]
#: {{pf|ru|спу́тать|перепу́тать}}
# to [[involve]] [[in]], to [[embroil]]
#: {{pf|ru|запу́тать|впу́тать}}
# ''(horses)'' to [[hobble]], to [[fetter]]
#: {{pf|ru|спу́тать}}

====Conjugation====
